span.p:
Kafka
3 sec ruka, thread atke
-> upload hote hi tracking id (T-101) do, khabar queue me
worker Validator chalaye, DB me DONE / FAILED, user id se haal dekhe
(async + tracking id)
worker beech me mara -> khabar dobara milti (offset baad me)
wahi khabar dobara -> DONE hai to skip (idempotent)
Validator 1 ghanta band -> khabar line me padi, offset aage nahi
us ghante call -> 3-5 fail pe band, phir test call (circuit breaker)
